### one field changed:
###   is_government_funded = yes  ->  is_government_funded = no

### EMITTED ONLY UNDER --private-bank, and it is not a free switch.
###
### is_government_funded means the treasury pays the building's inputs and
### wages and takes its output -- the government expenditure line in the
### building panel. Off, the central bank is an ordinary private business, and
### on a 1836 British save it makes 200 bonds plus currency against about 2.5K
### of inputs and wages. As a government building that gap is state spending;
### as a private one it is profit, dividends and investment-pool inflow, every
### month, for whoever owns the central bank.
###
### Turn this on only if ownership does not work without it, and then watch
### the investment pool rather than the ownership tab.
